records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Awareness|Reset Initiative
records.canonicalDescription: Scouts are highly aware of their surroundings and able to take advantage of the slightest opportunities. Once per encounter, at any time after the first full round (that is, the first full round after the surprise round, if one occurs), the scout can set his Initiative to his current Initiative +5.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Acute Senses, Improved Initiative, trained in the Initiative skill
records.quickSummary: Scouts are highly aware of their surroundings and able to take advantage of the slightest opportunities.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Bounty Hunter|Signature Item
records.canonicalDescription: You are famous for using certain items, and you have become skilled at wielding them. You select a single weapon, suit of armor, vehicle, starship, or other item. While wielding that weapon, wearing that armor, piloting that vehicle, or otherwise using that item, you gain a +2 morale bonus on opposed skill checks. You can select this talent multiple times. Each time you do so, you choose a new object to be your signature item. The effects of multiple signature items are cumulative with one another, increasing this morale bonus by 1 each time.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Duelist|Improved Lightsaber Throw
records.canonicalDescription: You can spend a Force Point as a standard action to throw your lightsaber at a group of opponents. You make a single ranged attack roll (treating the lightsaber as a thrown weapon) and compare the result to the Reflex Defense of all targets in a 6-square line originating in your square. If your attack roll result exceeds a target’s Reflex Defense, you deal normal lightsaber damage to that target (dealing half damage if you fail to exceed the target’s Reflex Defense). This attack is considered an area attack. You can pull your lightsaber back to your hand as a swift action by making a DC 20 Use the Force check.
records.quickSummary: You can spend a Force Point as a standard action to throw your lightsaber at a group of opponents.
records.repoBenefit: As a Standard Action, spend a Force Point to throw your Lightsaber through a 6-square line. You can pull your Lightsaber back with a Swift Action and a DC 20 Use the Force check.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Jedi Guardian|Mobile Combatant
records.canonicalDescription: When you end your movement adjacent to an opponent, you can spend a swift action to activate this talent. If the designated opponent moves or withdraws before the beginning of your next turn, you can choose to move with that opponent, up to a total distance equal to your current speed. Unless your opponent uses the withdraw action or makes an Acrobatics check to avoid attacks of opportunity, its movement provokes an attack of opportunity from you for the first square moved as normal (but not subsequent squares in the same movement). If your target moves farther than your speed, you must still end this movement closer to the target than you began.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Lineage|Influential Friends
records.canonicalDescription: You have influential contacts within a certain organization, planet, or region who can provide concrete information to you on certain subjects. Once per day, you can have one of those contacts make a skill check on your behalf. The contact always takes 20 on the skill check (even if the skill would normally not allow taking 20) and has a skill modifier equal to 5 + one-haIf your heroic level. Contacting your influential allies and receiving the benefit of the skill check takes a number of minutes equal to 10 x the skill check result.

records.repoDescription: You may place a mine as a standard action instead of a full-round action.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Sabotage|Shaped Explosion
records.canonicalDescription: You know how to set charges to direct a blast in a specific direction or manner. You can shape an explosion caused by explosives or mines that you set into a line or a cone instead of a radius. The length of the line is equal to 2 x the radius of the explosive blast, the length of the cone is equal to 3 x the radius of the blast, and either the line or the cone originates from the square where the explosives are placed.
records.quickSummary: You know how to set charges to direct a blast in a specific direction or manner.
records.repoBenefit: Create blasts in a line or cone: length = 2× radius; cone length = 3× blast radius; origin from explosive’s square.
records.repoDescription: Explosions may be shaped into a line or cone originating from the explosive's square.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Sabotage|Skilled Demolitionist
records.canonicalDescription: You can set a detonator as a swift action, and your explosives never go off as the detonator is being placed, even if you fail the check by 10 or more. You must still roll to determine if the charge otherwise goes off as planned (see “Mechanics,” page 69 of the Saga Edition core rulebook).
records.quickSummary: You can set a detonator as a swift action, and your explosives never go off as the detonator is being placed, even if you fail the check by 10 or more.
records.repoBenefit: Set a detonator as a swift action; explosives do not detonate on a failure by 10 or more.
records.repoDescription: Set a detonator as a swift action; explosives do not detonate if you fail by 10 or more.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Smuggling|Art of Concealment
records.canonicalDescription: Some smugglers are adept at hiding contraband and weapons, even on their person. When making a Stealth check to conceal an item, you can take 10 even under pressure. Additionally, you can conceal an item as a swift action.
records.quickSummary: Some smugglers are adept at hiding contraband and weapons, even on their person.
records.repoBenefit: Use Stealth to conceal items on your person; you can take 10 even if rushed; conceal as a swift action.
records.repoDescription: Use Stealth to conceal items on your person; may take 10 even when rushed.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Smuggling|Fast Talker
records.canonicalDescription: Smugglers must be quick to explain discrepancies in their cover stories. Once per day, you can take 20 on a Deception check as a standard action when attempting to deceive.
records.quickSummary: Smugglers must be quick to explain discrepancies in their cover stories.
records.repoBenefit: Once per day, take 20 on a Deception check as a standard action when attempting to deceive.
records.repoDescription: Once per day, take 20 on a Deception check when deceiving.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Smuggling|Hidden Weapons
records.canonicalDescription: If you draw a concealed weapon and attack a target that failed to notice the item in the same round, that target is considered flat-footed against you. You can draw a concealed item or a stowed item as a move action, Additionally, if you have the Quick Draw feat, you can reduce this to a swift action.
records.quickSummary: If you draw a concealed weapon and attack a target that failed to notice the item in the same round, that target is considered flat-footed against you.
records.repoBenefit: If a weapon you draw is unnoticed, the opponent is flat-footed; you may use Quick Draw as a swift action.
records.repoDescription: If a concealed weapon you draw is unnoticed, the opponent is flat-footed; you may use Quick Draw as a swift action.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Smuggling|Illicit Dealings
records.canonicalDescription: Smugglers have a knack for locating and negotiating illicit deals. When using Persuasion to haggle for restricted, military, or illegal goods you may roll twice, keeping the better result.
records.quickSummary: Smugglers have a knack for locating and negotiating illicit deals.
records.repoBenefit: Reroll Persuasion checks when haggling for restricted, military, or illegal goods.
records.repoDescription: Reroll Persuasion checks when haggling for restricted or illegal goods.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Smuggling|Surprise Strike
records.canonicalDescription: Sometimes a smuggler has to fight his way out of a bad situation. If you fail any Deception check to convey deceptive information, you can initiate combat and make a single unarmed attack as a free action in the surprise round (or with a melee or ranged weapon, if you have the Quick Draw feat); all other combatants are considered surprised even if they are aware of you.
records.quickSummary: Sometimes a smuggler has to fight his way out of a bad situation.
records.repoBenefit: If you fail a Deception check, make a single unarmed strike as a free action in the surprise round; or another attack with Quick Draw.
records.repoDescription: If you fail a Deception check, make a single unarmed or Quick Draw attack in the surprise round.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Specialized Droid|Computer Language
records.canonicalDescription: You can use your Persuasion modifier instead of your Use Computer modifier when making Use Computer checks. You are considered trained in the Use Computer skill for the purpose of using this talent. If you are entitled to a Use Computer check reroll, you can reroll your Persuasion check instead (subject to the same circumstances and limitations).
records.quickSummary: You can use your Persuasion modifier instead of your Use Computer modifier when making Use Computer checks.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Specialized Droid|Computer Master
records.canonicalDescription: You can reroll any opposed Use Computer check, using the better result.
records.quickSummary: You can reroll any opposed Use Computer check, using the better result.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Specialized Droid|Enhanced Manipulation
records.canonicalDescription: You have improved appendage manipulation routines. You can take 10 when making any Dexterity-based skill check, even if you are threatened or would not normally be able to take 10.
records.quickSummary: You have improved appendage manipulation routines.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Specialized Droid|Hotwired Processor
records.canonicalDescription: You gain temporary processing power, enhancing your mental attributes. When you hotwire your processor (a swift action), you gain a +5 circumstance bonus on Intelligence- and Wisdom-based skill checks and a +1 circumstance bonus on ranged attack rolls. A hotwiring lasts for a number of rounds equal to one-haIf your level (rounded down). When the hotwiring ends, you move -1 persistent step along the condition track. The penalties imposed by this condition persist until you receive repairs (using the repair droid application of the Mechanics skill).
records.quickSummary: You gain temporary processing power, enhancing your mental attributes.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Specialized Droid|Power Surge
records.canonicalDescription: You temporarily surge your power systems to enhance your physical abilities. When you initiate a power surge (a swift action), you gain a +1 circumstance bonus on melee attack rolls, +1 die of damage on melee damage rolls, and an increase of 2 squares to your speed. A power surge lasts for a number of rounds equal to one-haIf your level (rounded down). At the end of a power surge, you move -1 persistent step along the condition track. The penalties imposed by this condition persist until you receive repairs (using the repair droid application of the Mechanics skill).
records.quickSummary: You temporarily surge your power systems to enhance your physical abilities.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Specialized Droid|Skill Conversion
records.canonicalDescription: When you reprogram yourself, you can sacrifice a single trained skill for a bonus Skill Focus feat. You must meet the prerequisites for the feat (you must be trained in the skill you choose to gain Skill Focus for), and you can do this only once per reprogramming.
records.quickSummary: When you reprogram yourself, you can sacrifice a single trained skill for a bonus Skill Focus feat.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Spy|Blend In
records.canonicalDescription: You know the tricks of body language and movement that allow you to disguise your appearance without elaborate materials or efforts. You can use your Stealth modifier in place of your Deception modifier for the purpose of creating a deceptive appearance. You are considered trained in the Deception skill for the purpose of using this talent. If you are entitled to a Deception check reroll, you can reroll your Stealth check instead (subject to the same circumstances and conditions).
records.quickSummary: You know the tricks of body language and movement that allow you to disguise your appearance without elaborate materials or efforts.
records.repoBenefit: Use Stealth in place of Deception for a deceptive appearance; considered trained.
records.repoDescription: Use Stealth instead of Deception for creating deceptive appearances.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Spy|Incognito
records.canonicalDescription: Spies are adept at concealing their identities, even if not using a physical disguise. You can reroll your Deception check for the purpose of creating a deceptive appearance, using the better result.
records.quickSummary: Spies are adept at concealing their identities, even if not using a physical disguise.
records.repoBenefit: Reroll Deception checks for a deceptive appearance.
records.repoDescription: Reroll Deception checks when maintaining a disguise.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Spy|Improved Surveillance
records.canonicalDescription: When you successfully use the Surveillance talent, you grant yourself and your allies a +1 insight bonus to all defenses against that target.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Surveillance, trained in the Perception skill
records.quickSummary: When you successfully use the Surveillance talent, you grant yourself and your allies a +1 insight bonus to all defenses against that target.
records.repoBenefit: You and allies gain +1 to all defenses against the target.
records.repoDescription: Gain defensive bonuses against a surveilled target.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Spy|Intimate Knowledge
records.canonicalDescription: Experienced spies and scouts remember many details from previous assignments, providing insights on later missions. Once per encounter as a standard action, you can take 20 on a check involving a Knowledge skill you are trained in, or take 10 on a check involving a Knowledge skill you are untrained in, even if circumstances would not normally allow you to take 10 or 20.
records.quickSummary: Experienced spies and scouts remember many details from previous assignments, providing insights on later missions.
records.repoBenefit: Once per encounter, take 20 on a trained Knowledge check or take 10 on an untrained Knowledge check even if normally not allowed.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, take 20 on a Knowledge check.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Spy|Surveillance
records.canonicalDescription: As a full-round action, you can make a Perception check against a single target within line of sight. The DCs equal to 15 or the target's Stealth check result (if the target is actively trying to remain hidden), whichever is greater. If the check is successful, you grant yourself and all allies within line of sight a +2 insight bonus on attack rolls against that target until the end of your next turn. Your allies must be able to hear and understand you to benefit from this bonus, and they do not lose the benefit of this talent if they move out of line of sight after it is used.
records.quickSummary: As a full-round action, you can make a Perception check against a single target within line of sight.
records.repoBenefit: Make Perception vs a target in line of sight (DC 15 or Stealth if higher); you and allies gain +2 attack until next turn and while out of the target’s line of sight.
records.repoDescription: Gain attack bonuses against a target you successfully observe.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Spy|Traceless Tampering
records.canonicalDescription: Spies specialize in leaving no evidence of their presence when they tamper with advanced electronics or basic mechanical systems. When using Mechanics to disable a device, you automatically leave no trace when tampering (with no DC increase), and you must fail by 10 or more (instead of 5 or more) before something goes wrong.
records.quickSummary: Spies specialize in leaving no evidence of their presence when they tamper with advanced electronics or basic mechanical systems.
records.repoBenefit: Automatically leave no trace of tampering; on a failure by 10+, something goes wrong (instead of by 5).
records.repoDescription: You automatically leave no trace when tampering with devices.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Turret|Blaster Turret I
records.canonicalDescription: Once per encounter, as standard action you can create a blaster turret (Size Tiny, Initiative +4, Perception +4, Reflex Defense 10, 10 hp, Threshold 8) that can be mounted to any flat surface. The turret fires as a standard blaster pistol once per round, using your base attack bonus plus your Intelligence bonus and dealing 3d6 points of damage. The turret fires at any target you designate (a free action, once per round on your turn), though you must remain adjacent to the turret to control it. The turret is expended at the end of the encounter.
records.quickSummary: Once per encounter, as standard action you can create a blaster turret (Size Tiny, Initiative +4, Perception +4, Reflex Defense 10, 10 hp, Threshold 8) that can be mounted to any flat surface.
records.repoBenefit: 1/encounter deploy Tiny turret: Init +4, Perception +4, Reflex Def 10, 10 hp, threshold 8, damage 3d6; must be adjacent to you to operate.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, deploy a Tiny blaster turret adjacent to you with 3d6 damage.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Turret|Blaster Turret II
records.canonicalDescription: Your turret’s capabilities increase in the following ways: Initiative +8, Perception +8, Reflex Defense 12, 15 hp, Threshold 10, and the turret deals 3d8 points of damage. The turret can be directed by remote control at a range of 12 squares.
records.quickSummary: Your turret’s capabilities increase in the following ways: Initiative +8, Perception +8, Reflex Defense 12, 15 hp, Threshold 10, and the turret deals 3d8 points of damage.
records.repoBenefit: 1/encounter deploy improved Tiny turret: Init +8, Perception +8, Reflex Def 12, 15 hp, threshold 10, damage 3d8; remote range 12 squares.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, deploy a more powerful blaster turret that may be controlled remotely within 12 squares.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Turret|Blaster Turret III
records.canonicalDescription: Your turret gains the ability to fire twice per round, with a -5 penalty on each attack roll, and gains DR 5.
records.canonicalPrerequisites: Blaster Turret I, Blaster Turret II
records.quickSummary: Your turret gains the ability to fire twice per round, with a -5 penalty on each attack roll, and gains DR 5.
records.repoBenefit: 1/encounter deploy advanced Tiny turret: Init +8, Perception +8, Reflex Def 12, 15 hp, DR 5, threshold 10, fires twice per activation; remote range 12 squares.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, deploy an advanced blaster turret that fires twice per round and has damage reduction.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Turret|Ion Turret
records.canonicalDescription: You can construct a turret that is highly effective against droids. The turret deals ion damage instead of normal damage.
records.quickSummary: You can construct a turret that is highly effective against droids.
records.repoBenefit: 1/encounter deploy Tiny ion turret: Init +4, Perception +4, Reflex Def 10, 10 hp, threshold 8, deals 3d6 ion; must be adjacent to you to operate.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, deploy an ion turret adjacent to you.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Turret|Stun Turret
records.canonicalDescription: You can construct a nonlethal turret. The turret deals stun damage instead of normal damage.
records.quickSummary: You can construct a nonlethal turret.
records.repoBenefit: 1/encounter deploy Tiny stun turret: Init +4, Perception +4, Reflex Def 10, 10 hp, threshold 8, deals 3d6 stun; must be adjacent to you to operate.
records.repoDescription: Once per encounter, deploy a stun turret adjacent to you.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Turret|Turret Self-Destruct
records.canonicalDescription: Your turret self-destructs automatically when it reaches 0 hit points. It explodes in a 2-square radius, dealing its normal damage.!f you are adjacent to the turret, you can disable this feature as a reaction.
records.quickSummary: Your turret self-destructs automatically when it reaches 0 hit points.
records.repoBenefit: When a turret is reduced to 0 hp it self-destructs in a 2-square radius dealing its normal damage; you may disable it as a reaction if adjacent.
records.repoDescription: When a turret is reduced to 0 hit points, it explodes in a 2-square radius dealing its normal damage.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|1stdegree Droid|Dull the Pain
records.canonicalDescription: As a full-round action, you can make a DC 15 Treat Injury check on an adjacent living creature to move it +1 step along the condition track.
records.quickSummary: As a full-round action, you can make a DC 15 Treat Injury check on an adjacent living creature to move it +1 step along the condition track.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|1stdegree Droid|Interrogator
records.canonicalDescription: You can create an aura of unliving, emotionless menace that no biological creature can match, and combine it with the cruel application of medical knowledge. You can use your Treat Injury modifier on a Persuasion check to change attitude or intimidate. You must be adjacent to your target to use this ability, in addition to the normal requirements for these uses of the Persuasion skill.
records.quickSummary: You can create an aura of unliving, emotionless menace that no biological creature can match, and combine it with the cruel application of medical knowledge.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|1stdegree Droid|Medical Droid
records.canonicalDescription: When you use a medpac to perform first aid with the Treat Injury skill, the creature gains 2 hit points for every point by which your check exceeds the DC (rather than the normal 1 hit point).
records.quickSummary: When you use a medpac to perform first aid with the Treat Injury skill, the creature gains 2 hit points for every point by which your check exceeds the DC (rather than the normal 1 hit point).

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|2nddegree Droid|Adept Assistant
records.canonicalDescription: When you successfully aid another character on a Mechanics, Pilot, or Use Computer check, you add +5 to the check result (rather than the normal +2).
records.quickSummary: When you successfully aid another character on a Mechanics, Pilot, or Use Computer check, you add +5 to the check result (rather than the normal +2).

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|2nddegree Droid|Mechanics Mastery
records.canonicalDescription: You can always take 10 on a Mechanics check, even if distractions or hazardous circumstances would normally prevent you from doing so.
records.quickSummary: You can always take 10 on a Mechanics check, even if distractions or hazardous circumstances would normally prevent you from doing so.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|2nddegree Droid|Vehicle Mechanic
records.canonicalDescription: Once per day you can spend three swift actions in successive rounds to make a DC 20 Mechanics check to restore 1d8 hit points to a vehicle and move it +1 step along the condition track. You also restore 1 hit point to the vehicle for every paint by which you exceed the Mechanics check DC.
records.quickSummary: Once per day you can spend three swift actions in successive rounds to make a DC 20 Mechanics check to restore 1d8 hit points to a vehicle and move it +1 step along the condition track.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|3rddegree Droid|Etiquette
records.canonicalDescription: When you succeed on a Persuasion check to change attitude, you adjust the target's attitude by one additional step.
records.quickSummary: When you succeed on a Persuasion check to change attitude, you adjust the target's attitude by one additional step.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|3rddegree Droid|Helpful
records.canonicalDescription: Once per turn you can use the aid another action to assist any adjacent ally on a skill check as a swift action instead of a standard action.
records.quickSummary: Once per turn you can use the aid another action to assist any adjacent ally on a skill check as a swift action instead of a standard action.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|3rddegree Droid|Protocol
records.canonicalDescription: You always succeed on attempts to aid another on Deception, Knowledge, and Persuasion checks (no check required).
records.quickSummary: You always succeed on attempts to aid another on Deception, Knowledge, and Persuasion checks (no check required).

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|4thdegree Droid|Combat Repairs
records.canonicalDescription: Once per day, as a full-round action, you can use the Mechanics skill to repair yourself (using the repair droid application of the skill}, as opposed to the normal 1 hour.
records.quickSummary: Once per day, as a full-round action, you can use the Mechanics skill to repair yourself (using the repair droid application of the skill}, as opposed to the normal 1 hour.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|4thdegree Droid|Droid Smash
records.canonicalDescription: You can use your mechanical strength when wielding a melee weapon. You add 2 x your Strength bonus to melee damage rolls when wielding a weapon in one hand.
records.quickSummary: You can use your mechanical strength when wielding a melee weapon.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|4thdegree Droid|Targeting Package
records.canonicalDescription: You can take two consecutive swift actions in the same round to activate special targeting software. When you do so, you gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls and damage rolls on your next attack if your target is at point blank range (or within reach, for melee attacks) and within line of sight. You lose the benefit of this talent if you lose line of sight to your target or if you take any other action before making your attack. The effect of this talent stacks with that of the Point Blank Shot feat.
records.quickSummary: You can take two consecutive swift actions in the same round to activate special targeting software.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|5thdegree Droid|Cargo Hauler
records.canonicalDescription: You gain a +5 bonus on Strength-based skill checks. Additionally, you double your carrying capacity.
records.quickSummary: You gain a +5 bonus on Strength-based skill checks.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|5thdegree Droid|Environmentally Shielded
records.canonicalDescription: You gain a +5 equipment bonus to your Fortitude Defense against environmental hazards, including extreme atmospheric conditions and corrosion.
records.quickSummary: You gain a +5 equipment bonus to your Fortitude Defense against environmental hazards, including extreme atmospheric conditions and corrosion.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|5thdegree Droid|Power Supply
records.canonicalDescription: You have learned to reroute power through your system to act as a power generator, providing power to an E-Web blaster (or similar weapon requiring a power generator). Additionally, whenever you would normally spend three swift actions to recharge shields or reroute power on a vehicle or starship, you need spend only two swift actions instead.
records.quickSummary: You have learned to reroute power through your system to act as a power generator, providing power to an E-Web blaster (or similar weapon requiring a power generator).

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Agent Of Ossus|Buried Presence
records.canonicalTreeKey: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Agent of Ossus
records.canonicalDescription: You can spend a Force Point as a standard action to become immune to detection by the Force for 1 hour. During this time, you always avoid detection by characters who are using the sense force application of the Use the Force skill, and you cannot be the target of the farseeing power. You may use this as a reaction to another character attempting to locate you with Sense Force (but before the character locates you), and if you make a Use the Force check this power’s effect immediately ends.
records.quickSummary: You can spend a Force Point as a standard action to become immune to detection by the Force for 1 hour.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Agent Of Ossus|Conceal Other
records.canonicalTreeKey: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Agent of Ossus
records.canonicalDescription: When you use either the Buried Presence talent or the Vanish talent, you affect one other willing adjacent target, granting it the effect of that talent as well. You can select this talent multiple times. Each time you do so, it increases the number of adjacent willing targets you affect by one.
records.quickSummary: When you use either the Buried Presence talent or the Vanish talent, you affect one other willing adjacent target, granting it the effect of that talent as well.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Agent Of Ossus|Insightful Aim
records.canonicalTreeKey: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Agent of Ossus
records.canonicalDescription: You can spend a Force Point as a swift action to substitute your Use the Force modifier for your ranged attack bonus when making attacks with a ranged weapon until the beginning of your next turn.
records.quickSummary: You can spend a Force Point as a swift action to substitute your Use the Force modifier for your ranged attack bonus when making attacks with a ranged weapon until the beginning of your next turn.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Agent Of Ossus|Vanish
records.canonicalTreeKey: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Agent of Ossus
records.canonicalDescription: You can make a Use the Force check as a swift action to vanish from the sight of a single target within line of sight. If the result of your Use the Force check exceeds the target's Will Defense, you gain total concealment from that target until the beginning of your next turn, or until you make an attack roll or skill check against the target.
records.quickSummary: You can make a Use the Force check as a swift action to vanish from the sight of a single target within line of sight.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Alter|Illusion
records.canonicalDescription: As a standard action, you can spend a Force Point to create an illusion that seems perfectly real to anyone who views it. You designate the form and complexity of the illusion, as well as its size and location, and make a Use the Force check. When a creature views the illusion, compare the result of your Use the Force check to the creature's Will Defense; if your check result exceeds its Will Defense, it believes the illusion to be real. Any physical interaction with the illusion (such as touching it, passing through it, or shooting it with a blaster) immediately reveals the true nature of the illusion, and the creature is no longer deceived. The illusion lasts for a number of minutes equal to your heroic level. The illusion's size also affects your Use the Force check, applying a penalty for exceptionally large illusions. The penalties are -1 for Huge illusions, -2 for Gargantuan illusions, -5 for Colossal illusions, and -10 for Colossal (Frigate) or larger illusions. This is a mind-affecting effect.
records.quickSummary: As a standard action, you can spend a Force Point to create an illusion that seems perfectly real to anyone who views it.
records.repoBenefit: Use the Force vs Will Defense to create an illusion; see source details for specific effects.
records.repoDescription: Use the Force vs Will Defense to create a visual or auditory illusion.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Alter|Telekinetic Prodigy
records.canonicalDescription: When you take the Force Training feat and select move object as one of your Force powers, you can also select one extra power to add to your Force suite for free. This power must be one of the powers affected by the Telekinetic Savant talent. You can gain only one extra power each time you take the Force Training feat, regardless of how many times you choose the move object power.
records.quickSummary: When you take the Force Training feat and select move object as one of your Force powers, you can also select one extra power to add to your Force suite for free.
records.repoBenefit: Gain an extra use of the selected power from disarm, slam, thrust, or Move Object.
records.repoDescription: Gain an additional telekinetic Force power when you take Move Object.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Control|Force Exertion
records.canonicalDescription: When you select this talent, choose one Force power that you have in your Force power suite. As a reaction, you can remove any one Force power from your active suite to add an extra use of the Force power designated by this talent. Doing so moves you -1 persistent step along the condition track. This persistent condition is removed by resting for 1 minute. You can select this talent multiple times. Each time you do so, you choose a different Force power to be gained by using this talent.
records.quickSummary: When you select this talent, choose one Force power that you have in your Force power suite.
records.repoBenefit: Designate one Force power; remove another power to refresh the designated power; you move -1 step down the condition track for 1 minute.
records.repoDescription: Designate a Force power to replace another; you move -1 down the condition track for 1 minute.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Control|Indomitable Will
records.canonicalDescription: You can spend a Force Point as a standard action to become immune to all mind-affecting effects for 1 minute.
records.quickSummary: You can spend a Force Point as a standard action to become immune to all mind-affecting effects for 1 minute.
records.repoBenefit: Immune to all mind-affecting effects for 1 minute.
records.repoDescription: Gain immunity to all mind-affecting effects for 1 minute.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Dark Side|Wrath of the Dark Side
records.canonicalDescription: When you roll a natural 20 on a Use the Force check to activate a Force power that directly deals damage to a target, you can choose not to regain all of your spent Force powers as normal and instead the targets damaged by the power take half that damage again at the start of their next turn. Only powers that directly damage the target are subject to this talent, including corruption, Force blast, Force grip, Force lightning, Force slam, Force storm, Force thrust (only when spending a Force Point), and repulse (only when spending a Force Point).
records.quickSummary: On a natural 20 with a directly damaging Force power, forgo normal Force-power recovery to deal half that damage again at the start of the targets next turn.
records.repoBenefit: When you roll a natural 20 with a damage-dealing Force power, do not regain powers for damage; target also takes half damage again at the start of your next turn.
records.repoDescription: On a natural 20 with a damaging Force power, do not regain the power and deal half damage next turn.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Felucian Shaman|Detonate
records.canonicalDescription: When you use the Force blast power, you can spend a Force Point to compare the result of your Use the Force check to the Reflex Defense of all other characters, creatures, and droids within 2 squares of your target. If you exceed the Reflex Defense of those secondary targets, they also take damage from the Force blast, and if you fail to exceed their Reflex Defense, they take half damage instead. This is considered to be an area attack against the secondary targets (but not against the original target).
records.quickSummary: When you use the Force blast power, you can spend a Force Point to compare the result of your Use the Force check to the Reflex Defense of all other characters, creatures, and droids within 2 squares of your target.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Felucian Shaman|Hive Mind
records.canonicalDescription: You can use the telepathy application of the Use the Force skill as a swift action, and you automatically succeed (no roll required) if your target is a willing recipient on the same planet.
records.quickSummary: You can use the telepathy application of the Use the Force skill as a swift action, and you automatically succeed (no roll required) if your target is a willing recipient on the same planet.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Felucian Shaman|Infuse Weapon
records.canonicalDescription: You can spend a Force Point to infuse an unpowered melee weapon (one that does not require an energy cell) with the strength of the Force, making it resistant to the attacks of other weapons. Infusing the weapon takes a full-round action. From that point forward, when you wield the weapon, its damage reduction is doubled, and lightsabers do not ignore the weapon's damage reduction. When you spend a Force Point to modify the attack roll of an infused weapon, you also add 2 x the Force Point's result to the damage roll if the attack is a success.

records.canonicalIdentity: Force Unleashed Campaign Guide|Felucian Shaman|Sickening Blast
records.canonicalDescription: When you use the Force blast power, if your Use the Force check exceeds the target's Fortitude Defense, you can choose to move the target -1 step along the condition track. Doing so increases your Dark Side Score by 1.
